_doc: Fixtures whose recorded prompt is KNOWN to be out of date, waiting for the next combined re-record (npm run eval:ai -- --record --only <ids>). Each id maps to the change that made it stale. tests/tooling/ai-eval.test.ts requires the stale set to equal exactly these ids: a new stale fixture, or a listed one that is current again, fails the suite. Empty this list when re-recording.
s-victoria-breakdown: C1 breakdown outburst rule in the prompt
s-victoria-max: C1 breakdown outburst rule in the prompt
s-reginald-breakdown: C1 breakdown outburst rule in the prompt; C2 retry note on a planned-reveal turn
